articleBlocks: I started this puzzle with a dessert-ingredient read because Pistachio, Coffee, and Vanilla all live comfortably in that world.
That held for a moment, but Cookie dough made the board feel less like pantry items and more like something you would order.
That was the clue that changed the solve.
Cookie dough is much more natural as an ice cream flavor than as a baking category on its own.
Once I read it that way, Pistachio and Coffee stopped sounding like components and started sounding like freezer-case flavors.
Mint chocolate chip then became the clean final confirmation.
The answer was Flavors of ice cream.
Looking back, the puzzle works because every clue can appear in desserts, but only one category explains all five as named menu items.
